name: TIME
doc: Global time since the engine has started, in seconds. It repeats after every 3,600 seconds (which can be changed with the rollover setting). It's affected by time_scale but not by pausing. If you need a TIME variable that is not affected by time scale, add your own global shader uniform and update it each frame.

name: PI
doc: A PI constant (3.141592). A ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter and amount of radians in half turn.

name: TAU
doc: A TAU constant (6.283185). An equivalent of PI * 2 and amount of radians in full turn.

name: E
doc: An E constant (2.718281). Euler's number and a base of the natural logarithm.

name: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB
doc: true when output is in sRGB color space (this is true in the Compatibility renderer, false in Forward+ and Mobile).

name: CLIP_SPACE_FAR
doc: Clip space far z value. In the Forward+ or Mobile renderers, it's 0.0. In the Compatibility renderer, it's -1.0.

name: VIEWPORT_SIZE
doc: Size of viewport (in pixels).

name: FRAGCOORD
doc: Coordinate of pixel center in screen space. xy specifies position in window, z specifies fragment depth if DEPTH is not used. Origin is lower-left.

name: MODEL_MATRIX
doc: Model/local space to world space transform.

name: INV_VIEW_MATRIX
doc: View space to world space transform.

name: VIEW_MATRIX
doc: World space to view space transform.

name: PROJECTION_MATRIX
doc: View space to clip space transform.

name: INV_PROJECTION_MATRIX
doc: Clip space to view space transform.

name: NORMAL
doc: Normal vector, in view space.

name: SCREEN_UV
doc: Screen UV coordinate for current pixel.

name: UV
doc: UV that comes from the vertex() function.

name: UV2
doc: UV2 that comes from the vertex() function.

name: VIEW
doc: View vector, in view space.

name: LIGHT
doc: Light vector, in view space.

name: LIGHT_COLOR
doc: Light color multiplied by light energy multiplied by PI. The PI multiplication is present because physically-based lighting models include a division by PI.

name: SPECULAR_AMOUNT
doc: For OmniLight3D and SpotLight3D, 2.0 multiplied by light_specular. For DirectionalLight3D, 1.0.

name: LIGHT_IS_DIRECTIONAL
doc: true if this pass is a DirectionalLight3D.

name: ATTENUATION
doc: Attenuation based on distance or shadow.

name: ALBEDO
doc: Base albedo.

name: METALLIC
doc: Metallic.

name: ROUGHNESS
doc: Roughness.

name: DIFFUSE_LIGHT
doc: Diffuse light result.

name: SPECULAR_LIGHT
doc: Specular light result.

name: ALPHA
doc: Alpha (range of [0.0, 1.0]). If written to, the material will go to the transparent pipeline.
